title: Electronic Filing of Complaints with District Commissions

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint electronically with a District Commission, using the prescribed online portal, against a company for selling defective goods.
content.outcome: The complaint under this sub-section may be filed electronically, in the manner prescribed, allowing consumers to easily and conveniently file complaints with District Commissions.

user_queries: Can complaints be filed electronically with District Commissions?
How can complaints be filed electronically?
What are the benefits of electronic filing?
